### Ulichotuambia

```{r include=FALSE}
library(lubridate)
#library(kableExtra)
#rmarkdown::html_document
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')


personalized_info <- read.csv("../temp/FR_MarkDownText.csv")

personalized_info$current_yield <- round(personalized_info$current_yield, digits=0)
 
personalized_info$actualmn <- lubridate::month(ymd(personalized_info$plant_date))
personalized_info$month  <- month.abb[personalized_info$actualmn]
personalized_info$actuald <- lubridate::day(ymd(personalized_info$plant_date))
personalized_info$actualday <- lubridate::wday(ymd(personalized_info$plant_date))
personalized_info$actualYR <- lubridate::year(ymd(personalized_info$plant_date))
personalized_info$plant_date2 <- paste(personalized_info$actuald, personalized_info$month, personalized_info$actualYR, sep = "-")
 	
personalized_info$actualmn <- lubridate::month(ymd(personalized_info$hvst_date))
personalized_info$month  <- month.abb[personalized_info$actualmn]
personalized_info$actuald <- lubridate::day(ymd(personalized_info$hvst_date))
personalized_info$actualday <- lubridate::wday(ymd(personalized_info$hvst_date))
personalized_info$actualYR <- lubridate::year(ymd(personalized_info$hvst_date))
personalized_info$hvst_date2 <- paste(personalized_info$actuald, personalized_info$month, personalized_info$actualYR, sep = "-")



totalRevenuemoney <-read.csv("../temp/totalRevenuemoney.csv")
totalSalemoney <-read.csv("../temp/totalSalemoney.csv")
totalCostmoney <-read.csv("../temp/totalCostmoney.csv")



# for (i in 1:nrow(personalized_info)){
# # 
 name <- personalized_info$name
 #phone <-  as.character(paste(personalized_info$userPhoneCC, personalized_info$phone, sep=" "))
 phone <- as.character(personalized_info$phone)
 field <- personalized_info$field
 field_area <- personalized_info$field_area
 plant_date <- personalized_info$plant_date2
 hvst_date <- personalized_info$hvst_date2
 current_yield<- personalized_info$current_yield
code <- personalized_info$userPhoneCC
unit_field <- ifelse(personalized_info$unit_field == "ha", "hekta", "ekari")
```   
 

 <font size="4">  Jina lako:**`r sprintf("<span class='custom-inline'>%s</span>", name)`**
 <br>
   Namba ya simu: + **`r sprintf("<span class='custom-inline'>%s</span>", phone)`**  
  
  
  Shamba lako: **`r sprintf("<span class='custom-inline'>%s</span>", field)`** 
  <br>
   Ukubwa wa shamba: **`r unit_field` `r sprintf("<span class='custom-inline'>%s</span>", field_area)`  **
 <br>
  Tarehe ya kupanda: **`r sprintf("<span class='custom-inline'>%s</span>", plant_date)`**
  <br>
  Tarehe ya kuvuna: **`r sprintf("<span class='custom-inline'>%s</span>", hvst_date)`**

  
  Mavuno yako ya sasa: <b>Kama tani</b> **`r sprintf("<span class='custom-inline'>%s</span>", current_yield)` kwa kila  `r unit_field`**
 
 </font>

### Bei ya mbolea


```{r include=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
 options(knitr.table.format = 'markdown')
library(dplyr)

personalized_info <- read.csv("../temp/FR_MarkDownText.csv")

dds <- NULL
if (file.exists("../temp/datall1.csv")) {
  da1 <-read.csv("../temp/datall1.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  costt <- formatC(da1$total_cost1, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  #costt <- formatC(signif(da1$total_cost1, digits=3), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  da1$unit <- gsub(" bag", "", da1$unit1)
  da1$kgs1 <- round(da1$kgs1, digits=0)
  da1title1 <-  paste(da1$fertilizer1, ": kilo ", da1$kgs1, " kwa ekari", " ", da1$field_area, " ",  " (~", " mifuko ", " ", da1$bags1, " ", "ya kilo",  " ", da1$unit, ")"," = ",
                      costt, " ", da1$currency, sep="")
  da1bag <- da1[,c("rep")]
  
  dds <- data.frame(type = as.character(da1$fertilizer1), cost=round(da1$costPerBag1, digits = 0),
                    units = as.character(da1$unit1), currency=as.character(da1$currency))
  dds$units <- ifelse(dds$units == "50kg bag", "mfuko wa kilo hamsini", as.character(dds$units))
}else{
  da1 <- NULL
}


if (file.exists("../temp/datall2.csv")){
  da2 <-read.csv("../temp/datall2.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  #cost2 <- formatC(signif(da2$total_cost2, digits=3), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  cost2 <- formatC(da2$total_cost2, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  da2$unit <- gsub(" bag", "", da2$unit2)
  da2$kgs2 <- round(da2$kgs2, digits=0)
  da2title1 <-  paste(da2$fertilizer2, ": kilo ", da2$kgs2, " kwa ekari", " ", da2$field_area, " ",  " (~", " mifuko ", " ", da2$bags2, " ", "ya kilo",  " ", da2$unit, ")"," = ",
                      cost2, " ", da2$currency, sep="")
  da2bag <-da2[,c("rep")]
  
  dds <- rbind(dds, data.frame(type = as.character(da2$fertilizer2), cost=round(da2$costPerBag2, digits = 0),
                               units = as.character(da2$unit2), currency=as.character(da2$currency)))
   dds$units <- ifelse(dds$units == "50kg bag", "mfuko wa kilo hamsini", as.character(dds$units))
  
} else{
  da2 <- NULL
}

if (file.exists("../temp/datall3.csv")){
  da3 <-read.csv("../temp/datall3.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  #cost3 <- formatC(signif(da3$total_cost3, digits=3), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)

                      cost3, " ", da3$currency, sep="")
  da3bag <- da3[,c("rep")]

                               units = as.character(da3$unit3), currency=as.character(da3$currency)))
   dds$units <- ifelse(dds$units == "50kg bag", "mfuko wa kilo hamsini", as.character(dds$units))
} else{

if (file.exists("../temp/datall4.csv")){

   dds$units <- ifelse(dds$units == "50kg bag", "mfuko wa kilo hamsini", as.character(dds$units))
} else{

}

if (file.exists("../temp/datall5.csv")){
  da5 <-read.csv("../temp/datall5.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  #cost5 <- formatC(signif(da5$total_cost5, digits=3), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  cost5 <- formatC(da5$total_cost5, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)

                               units = as.character(da5$unit5), currency=as.character(da5$currency)))
   dds$units <- ifelse(dds$units == "50kg bag", "mfuko wa kilo hamsini", as.character(dds$units))
} else{
  da5 <- NULL
}
 
 priceinfo <- unique(dds)
if (!is.null(priceinfo) && nrow(priceinfo) > 0) {
#priceinfo$type <- priceinfo$fertname
#priceinfo$cost <- formatC(signif(priceinfo$cost, digits=3), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
priceinfo$cost <- formatC(priceinfo$cost, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
priceinfo$cost <- paste(" @", " ", priceinfo$cost, " ", priceinfo$currency, " ", "kwa", sep="")
priceinfo$unit <- priceinfo$unit
priceinfo$tts <- paste(priceinfo$cost, " ", priceinfo$unit, sep="")
priceinfo <-priceinfo[, c("type", "tts")]
} else { priceinfo <- data.frame(type=character(0), tts=character(0)) } 
# x = kable(priceinfo, format="html") %>%
#   column_spec(1, bold = T) %>%
#     kable_styling(full_width = F)

costcassava <- personalized_info$costcassava

unitcassava <- paste(" tani ya ", personalized_info$unitcassava, sep="")

area <- paste(personalized_info$field_area, personalized_info$unit_field, sep=" ")
cas_unit <- personalized_info$unit_field

}
```

### Eneo lilipo shamba lako
 <div class = "col-md-6">

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, warning = FALSE, results='hide'}

#setwd("D:/ACAI_Wrapper/cloud_compute")
personalized_info <- read.csv("../temp/FR_MarkDownText.csv")
geodata <- personalized_info
#setwd("D:/ACAI_Wrapper/fertilizer advice Rmd")

# geodata <- read.csv("../temp/FR_MarkDownText.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# geodata <- unique(geodata)
#geodata <- read.csv(file = "MarkDownTextD.csv", header = TRUE,  sep = "," )
data <- subset(geodata[1,], select = c("name", "latitude", "longitude"))

minLong=data$longitude - 0.05
maxLong=data$longitude + 0.05
minLat=data$latitude - 0.05
maxLat=data$latitude + 0.05
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)
my_map <- data %>%
  
  #leaflet(width = "10%") %>%
  #leaflet(options= leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 10)) %>%
  leaflet(options= leafletOptions(minZoom = 8, maxZoom = 10)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.NatGeoWorldMap)%>%
  #setView(lng = -95.7129, lat = 37.0902, zoom = 4) %>%
  
  # addMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude
  #          )%>% 
  #addRectangles(lat1 = minLat, lng1 = minLong, lat2 = maxLat, lng2 = maxLong)%>% 
  addCircleMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude, color="white", fillColor = "transparent", weight = 10, radius = 30)%>% 
  
  addScaleBar()
#addTiles()
mm <- "my_map.png"
if (file.exists(mm)) file.remove(mm)

mapshot(my_map,  height=150, file="map.png")
```
